e.title: insurance-copula
e.summary: Vine copula 多风险定价（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：暴露加权依赖建模，家庭多风险保险
e.summary_en: Vine copulas for multi-peril pricing (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): exposure-weighted dependence modelling for home multi-peril insurance
e.summary_hk: Vine copula 多風險定價（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：暴露加權依賴建模，家庭多風險保險
e.body: insurance-copula（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用 Vine copula 做多风险（multi-peril）保险定价：暴露加权的依赖结构建模、D-vine 时序依赖——家庭保险等复合风险场景。对 RIAA：风险依赖是精算建模的关键维度——[[insurance-frequency-severity]]（Sarmanov copula 联合频率-严重度）管两维、Vine copula 管高维依赖结构；多风险产品（家庭/商业）定价必须处理风险间相关性；与 [[insurance-synthetic]]（vine copula 合成数据）配套。
e.body_en: insurance-copula (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) uses Vine copulas for multi-peril insurance pricing: exposure-weighted dependence structures, D-vine temporal dependence — compound-risk lines like home insurance. For RIAA: risk dependence is a key dimension of actuarial modelling — [[insurance-frequency-severity]] (Sarmanov joint frequency-severity) handles two dimensions, Vine copulas scale to high-dimensional dependence; multi-peril products (home/commercial) must price risk correlation; pairs with [[insurance-synthetic]] (vine copula synthetic data).
e.body_hk: insurance-copula（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用 Vine copula 做多風險（multi-peril）保險定價：暴露加權的依賴結構建模、D-vine 時序依賴——家庭保險等複合風險場景。對 RIAA：風險依賴是精算建模的關鍵維度——[[insurance-frequency-severity]]（Sarmanov copula 聯合頻率-嚴重度）管兩維、Vine copula 管高維依賴結構；多風險產品（家庭/商業）定價必須處理風險間相關性；與 [[insurance-synthetic]]（vine copula 合成數據）配套。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.1.0 + GitHub README（家族成员），未实测
